currentPeriod.label: Ofgem price cap, 1 October to 31 December 2026
currentPeriod.sourceName: Ofgem energy price cap unit rates and standing charges
notes: Rounded national Direct Debit averages for England, Scotland and Wales; not Northern Ireland.
Electricity is zero-rated for VAT in this period; gas rates include 5% VAT.
Your supplier, region, payment method and meter type affect your tariff. Fixed and multi-rate tariffs differ.
The annual cap figure is an annualised typical-consumption benchmark, not a limit on your bill.
